description: This file defines the OrcColumnStatistics class, which wraps ORC ColumnStatistics objects and manages nested statistics for complex data types in ORC files, used for data schema analysis and pushdown optimizations.

classes.name: OrcColumnStatistics
classes.description: A class that encapsulates ORC ColumnStatistics and supports nested child statistics for complex data types like struct, map, and array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a child OrcColumnStatistics by its ordinal index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a child OrcColumnStatistics to the list of children.
